Topics.title: What You'll Learn
Topics.subtitle: Integrated learning paths designed to bridge academic theory and real-world industrial practice.

gis.title: Geographic Information Systems (GIS)
gis.desc: Spatial data management, georeferencing, topological & network analysis, and building robust enterprise Geodatabases.

remoteSensing.title: Remote Sensing & Satellite Imagery
remoteSensing.desc: Processing Landsat/Sentinel imagery, spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI), and supervised/unsupervised machine learning classification.

surveying.title: Engineering & Digital Surveying
surveying.desc: Coordinate reference systems, map projections, datum transformations, DEM/DTM digital elevation modeling and contouring.

spatialModeling.title: Spatial Modeling & Suitability
spatialModeling.desc: Multi-Criteria Evaluation (MCE) modeling, environmental hazard assessment, ModelBuilder automation, and ArcGIS Spatial Analyst.

gee.title: Google Earth Engine (GEE)
gee.desc: Cloud-based planetary-scale geospatial big data analytics, custom JavaScript/Python scripting, and environmental change detection.

arcgisPro.title: ArcGIS Pro Mastery
arcgisPro.desc: Mastering modern Esri toolsets, advanced cartographic styling, 3D spatial scenes, layout automation, and production publishing.
